meaningful_controls.underdominance_moves_away: w11=w22=1, w12=1/2, p=2/5: Delta p < 0 (moves away from the interior equilibrium 1/2, which is fixed) while wbar still rises: monotone wbar does not mean convergence to polymorphism.
meaningful_controls.fisher_fails_without_positivity: w11=-1, w12=1, w22=0, p=1/2 (wbar=1/4>0): p'=0 and wbar drops to 0; the conclusion is false once fitness positivity is dropped, so the hypotheses are load-bearing (sign is that of wbar + p w11 + q w22).

formulation_achieved: One locus, two alleles, discrete generations, viability selection, HW zygote proportions, w11,w12,w22 > 0, p in [0,1]: (i) p' in [0,1]; (ii) Delta p = pq(p(w11-w12)+q(w12-w22))/wbar = pq wbar'(p)/(2 wbar) with wbar' the real derivative (deriv); exact identity wbar(p')-wbar(p) = pq s^2 (wbar + p w11 + q w22)/wbar^2 (found by sympy, kernel-checked); (iii) wbar(p') >= wbar(p). Hardy-Weinberg: one round of random mating gives (p^2,2pq,q^2), preserves allele frequency, and is stationary. Scope: this is the one-locus two-allele mean-fitness monotonicity, NOT Fisher's general FTNS (partial change / additive genetic variance interpretation).
wording: First formalization of a known classical result; not a discovery.
